name: ACF Copilot – LivePreview, Code Snippets & Group Addons
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Improve Advanced Custom Fields workflows with LivePreview, field search, inline help, custom code snippets, HTML components, and field group bulk delete.

Ready to transform your ACF workflow? Watch this quick demonstration to see how ACF Copilot can revolutionize your projects:

Gain clarity with inline help, which provides context-sensitive guidance and tips, ensuring you get the most out of every feature. Effortlessly create custom solutions using ready-to-use HTML components that are compatible with Bootstrap 5, giving your projects a professional edge.

Manage your field groups like never before with bulk delete, making it easy to organize, clean up, and optimize your fields for better performance and usability.

Explore the full potential of ACF Copilot and take your WordPress development to the next level!

USAGE

Once the plugin is uploaded and activated:

  1. Navigate to ACF Copilot in the main menu to access all features.
  2. Use the settings to configure options such as AI Code Snippets, LivePreview, and bulk management tools.

Here are the steps to use ACF Copilot Pro:

  1. Open the Field Group Manager in ACF.
  2. Use AI Code Snippets to generate reusable templates for field groups.
  3. Enable LivePreview to view changes directly on posts, pages, or custom post types.
  4. Utilize the Unused Custom Fields Cleaner to tidy up your database.
  5. Perform bulk deletion for field groups.

Note: Free features include limited functionality, while Pro features offer advanced capabilities such as full editor support and AI-driven tools.

After Activation

  1. Click the Settings link or navigate to ACF Copilot in the main menu.
  2. Explore features like LivePreview, AI-powered tools, and bulk field group management.

FEATURES & LIMITATIONS

The ACF Copilot Pro plugin allows you to:

  • Generate AI-powered code snippets for field groups, repeaters, and flexible content layouts.
  • Streamline workflows with a LivePreview feature for posts, pages, and custom post types.
  • Effortlessly clean up unused custom fields to declutter your database.
  • Enjoy bulk deletion for field groups.
  • Quickly find fields with Field Search across all field groups (Ctrl/Cmd + K).
  • Access ready-to-use Base and Bootstrap 5 HTML components for faster development.

Known Issues and Limitations

  • The AI Generator and LivePreview for custom post types are not available in the free version.
  • Unused custom fields cleaning is a Pro-only feature.
  • Priority support and updates are only included with the Pro version.
  • Regular updates for the free version may be delayed compared to the Pro version.

DETAILED DOCUMENTATION

Find step-by-step setup guides, usage instructions, demos, videos, and insights on the ACF Copilot Pro page.

ACF COPILOT PRO

If you’re using the free version from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the ACF Copilot Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • AI-generated Code Snippets for groups, repeatable, and flexible content.
  • Powerful AI Generator for Field Groups.
  • LivePreview support for posts, pages, and custom post types.
  • Full compatibility with the block editor and classic editor in LivePreview.
  • Unused Custom Fields Cleaner to declutter your database.
  • Priority email support and updates for one year.
  • Access to custom options with full support.
sections.installation:
The plugin installation is easy and straightforward. Let us know if you run into any issues.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the acf-copilot folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to Plugins.
  3. Activate the ACF Copilot plugin.

After Activation

  1. Click the Settings link or navigate to ACF Copilot in the main menu.
  2. You can now use the LivePreview and all other functionalities available for ACF field groups.
sections.faq:
Visit the Support page to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

Does ACF Copilot work with all field groups?

Yes, ACF Copilot supports all field groups created using Advanced Custom Fields. Some advanced features, like AI-generated snippets and LivePreview for custom post types, are only available in the Pro version.

Will the plugin modify my existing ACF fields?

No, the plugin does not modify your existing fields or data. It enhances your workflow with tools like bulk actions and LivePreview, ensuring your original fields remain intact.

Can I use ACF Copilot with WordPress Multisite?

The free version does not support WordPress Multisite. For multisite compatibility, you’ll need the Pro version.

Does ACF Copilot support the block editor?

Yes, LivePreview works with both the classic editor and the block editor in the Pro version. The free version supports only the classic editor.

Do I need coding skills to use ACF Copilot?

Not at all! The plugin is beginner-friendly and offers tools like AI-generated code snippets and ready-to-use HTML components to help users of all skill levels.

Do you provide support for the free version?

Limited support is available for the free version. Priority support and faster response times are included in the Pro version. For more details, visit ACF Copilot Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New – Field Search feature: Instantly find any ACF field across all field groups with Ctrl/Cmd+K keyboard shortcut or Search Fields button
  • New – LivePreview auto-refresh: Preview window automatically updates after clicking Update/Publish button
  • Update – LivePreview completely rewritten with modern architecture: Now works with both Classic and Block (Gutenberg) editors
  • Update – LivePreview improvements: Event-driven instead of polling, 2-second debouncing, visual syncing indicator, better error handling
  • Update – Enhanced instructions: Added step-by-step usage guide in LivePreview metabox and onboarding notice
  • Update – WP Pointers: Now shows helpful pointer on plugin activation highlighting main menu
  • Fix – HTML Components: Fixed AJAX handler, nonce verification, and component path mapping
  • Fix – Bulk Delete: Added CSS to disable ACF native drag handles when bulk checkboxes are selected
  • Remove – Bulk Drag & Drop: Removed feature entirely as it conflicted with ACF’s native functionality
  • Improve – Better code organization, updated documentation, and various performance optimizations

1.0.5

  • Fix – Add proper sanitization missing for register_setting()
  • Fix – Added stricter nonce verification using check_admin_referer() and check_ajax_referer() instead of manual checks; Introduced capability checks (current_user_can( 'manage_options' )) before allowing dismiss or update actions; Ensured unauthorized users cannot bypass dismissal or settings updates
  • Fix – Temoporary remove wp_remote_get it needs file url use back file_get_contents
  • Update – Remove load_plugin_textdomain() has been discouraged since WordPress version 4.6

1.0.4

  • Update – Remove the bitly.com links with raw and direct links with analytics params
  • Fix – Notice translation loading for the acf-copilot domain was triggered too early

1.0.3

  • Update – Compatibility tested with WordPress 6.8
  • Update – Compatibility tested with ACF 6.4

1.0.2

  • New – Hide setting options notices after save
  • Update – Performance and optimization compatibility
  • Update – Improve overall code quality
  • Update – Change year from 2024 -> 2025 all over
  • Fix – Minor JS and CSS fixes

1.0.1

  • New – Add PRO plugin comparison table under Settings
  • Update – Development env setup and CSS assets updates
  • Fix – Sanitize all database fields that are missing one
  • Fix – Use wp_json_encode instead of json_encode
  • Fix – Replace all file_get_contents with wp_remote_get

1.0.0

  • New – Release the first standalone version based on the pro plugin.
